name: Kyonyuu Dosukebe Gakuen ~Shojo-tachi no Tomaranai Koshizukai~
original_name: 巨乳ドスケベ学園～処女たちの止まらない腰使い～
source: At the protagonist school there is a famous club of girls said to bully and target men breaking them down with sex until they are like lifeless husks an move on to next victim. rumor says all them combine have had over 200 sex partners. One day on train the protagonist is able to hear conversation between college girls and club girls. Turns out they are all virgins who never had sex before. Unlucky (or lucky) for protagonist he is caught eavesdropping. That is day they decide to silence protagonist by finally living up to rumors by making him there target of club.
translation: 在主角学校里，有一个著名的女孩俱乐部，据说她们会欺负和瞄准男性，通过性行为将她们打垮，直到她们像毫无生气的躯壳一样，转向下一个受害者。有传言说他们总共有超过200名性伴侣。有一天，在火车上，主角听到大学女生和俱乐部女孩之间的对话。原来她们都是处女，以前从未发生过性行为。对于主角来说，他被抓到窃听是不幸的（或幸运的）。那天，他们决定让主角沉默，最终不辜负谣言，让他成为俱乐部的目标。
